_readme: CHECK constraints on the session-record tables, as pg_get_constraintdef prints them. Diffed by scripts/check-session-record-checks.mjs in check-schema.yml. Regenerate with --write only for a deliberate change.

checks.bookmarks.bookmarks_catalog_link_check: CHECK (((vintage_id IS NULL) OR (product_id IS NOT NULL)))
checks.moment_defaults.moment_defaults_visibili: CHECK (((visibility IS NULL) OR ((visibility)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['members'::character varying, 'friends'::character varying, 'followers'::character varying, 'verre'::character varying])::text[]))))
checks.ratings.ratings_session_rater_known: CHECK (((session_id IS NULL) OR (user_id IS NOT NULL) OR (tombstone_key IS NOT NULL)))
checks.sessions.sessions_visibility_chk: CHECK (((visibility IS NULL) OR ((visibility)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['members'::character varying, 'friends'::character varying, 'followers'::character varying, 'verre'::character varying])::text[]))))
checks.wines.wines_added_by_identity_id_chk: CHECK (((added_by_identity_id IS NULL) OR ((added_by_identity_id)::text ~ '^u:[0-9]+$'::text) OR ((added_by_identity_id)::text ~* '^a:[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'::text) OR ((added_by_identity_id)::text ~* '^d:[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'::text)))
checks.wines.wines_catalog_link_check: CHECK (((vintage_id IS NULL) OR (product_id IS NOT NULL)))
checks.wines.wines_colour_check: CHECK (((colour IS NULL) OR ((colour)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['red'::character varying, 'white'::character varying, 'rose'::character varying])::text[]))))
checks.wines.wines_origin_check: CHECK (((origin IS NULL) OR ((origin)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['session'::character varying, 'standalone'::character varying])::text[]))))
